llm_response.reason: The website https://dexdigitalmarket.com.simplebittstockoption.com/ exhibits multiple characteristics of a scam website. The domain 'simplebittstockoption.com' has been banned for abuse according to WHOIS retrieval. Search results from Scamadviser indicate a very low trust score for the website, suggesting it is likely a scam. The content of the website promises unusually high returns on investments and claims to be a successful and licensed company, which are common tactics used in investment scams. The presence of testimonials from clients further supports this classification.
